h3: Clothing brand in the aesthetics of slow living
p: Blending nostalgic charm with a modern graphic approach, Pachentro reimagines Italian heritage through a new lens – bold, minimal, and consciously relaxed.
The name echoes ease, confidence, and timeless cool – think vintage photos of Princess Diana in sweatshirts, or the effortless looks of Hailey Bieber and Kendall Jenner off duty.

/projects/archenum.title: Archenum – Web Experience Case Study | Zaveriya Studio
/projects/archenum.description: Discover how Zaveriya Studio created the brand identity, visual system, and guest experience touchpoints for Archenum. Full case study and design deliverables.
p: It's a numerology-based archetypal system and digital calculator designed to decode a person through numbers and translate that information into lived, embodied experience.

At its core, Archenum works with key numerical layers — mission, thinking, realization, life cycles, and transition points  — using deep, non-pop numerological logic rooted in Süçai and Pythagorean formulas. These calculations go beyond surface traits, revealing underlying patterns that shape identity, perception, and behavior

/projects/from.title: From – Branding Case Study | Zaveriya Studio
/projects/from.description: Discover how Zaveriya Studio created the brand identity, visual system, and guest experience touchpoints for From. Full case study and design deliverables.
p: From — is a modern fast food concept built around clean meat, transparency, and quality. It’s an open-door space for everyone: athletes, mindful eaters, and families with kids.

All ingredients are produced in-house — from buns and sauces to halal-certified beef and chicken raised on the mountain pastures of the North Caucasus. No additives, no flavour enhancers — just honest recipes, signature sauces, and a custom meat-cooking method.

/projects/adastra.description: Discover how Zaveriya Studio created the brand identity, visual system, and guest experience touchpoints for AdAstra. Full case study and design deliverables.
h3: Astro Shop Of Sacred Objects & Souvenirs
p: Branded mystical souvenirs from a modern astrologer.
Zodiac-inspired gifts, candles, rituals & celestial design — created to connect, inspire, and elevate your everyday magic.

“Ad Astra” means “to the stars” in Latin. The logo is built around this aspiration. The first A incorporates a central star, symbolising guidance, clarity, and inner light. The second A subtly evokes a rising star — its upward stroke forming a path from above, representing ascension and alignment with a higher purpose.
